name: public-api-reachable

finding.title: Days are converted to seconds, not milliseconds
finding.description: The new `d` branch returns `value * 86_400`, the number of seconds in a day, while every other unit returns milliseconds. `parseDuration('1d')` gives 86.4 seconds, so a cache TTL or timeout set in days expires about a thousand times too early. The package's own callers only pass `s` and `m`, but `parseDuration` is exported from the entry point and accepts any of the units its regular expression allows.

checks: src/duration.ts:12 says the function is exported from the package entry point
